usedFor: Zoho Connect holds the announcements, and Google Drive creates a document after “New Announcement”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Announcement” in Zoho Connect, then “Create a new sheet or doc or slide” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: An announcement is worth a working file, so a Doc, Sheet or Slide is made in a folder you choose.

watchOut: “Delete File” also pairs with these triggers and deletes permanently, so keep it out of this flow.
